name: io.github.himanshu748/contextfirewall
description: Trust firewall for AI coding-agent memory: audits remembered facts before they reach your agent.

environmentVariables.name: CF_API_BASE
environmentVariables.description: ContextFirewall API base URL. Point this at your own instance so your memories and your inference spend stay yours. Defaults to the public read-only demo.

environmentVariables.name: CF_API_KEY
environmentVariables.description: ContextFirewall API key (cf_live_...). Scopes reads and writes to your private namespace. Without it the server talks to the read-only demo.

environmentVariables.name: CF_HTTP_TIMEOUT
environmentVariables.description: Request timeout in seconds. Defaults to 120.
